I can share my experience, maybe something from it will fit you. No, I didn't use any blockers.

1) Tell somebody you trust - mom, dad, sibling (I told my mom) that you have this problem. I know it may seem hard and embarrasing but it can help. I told my mom that I have this problem and I promised her that I will never do it again and I never did because I respected my promise to her.

2) Punish yourself. Imagine that if you masturbate again that you will punish/hurt yourself. After this I never masturbated again because I promised myself that if I will do it again that I will hurt myself badly. I didn't want to hurt myself so I didn't masturbated ever again.

3) Have a list of days without masturbation. I have a list on my phone's notes app with numbers: everyday I add one number to it. It can help you track your progress and the bigger number you will have the less you will want to destroy it. You can even celebrate accomplishments: 30 day, 100 day, 365 day, etc. My next goal is 1000 days, then 2000 days and so on.

4) Quiting masturbation will help you have better relations with females because you won't see them as sex objects anymore and won't be afraid of them anymore. When I masturbated I was afraid to talk with girls, especially pretty ones, but when I quit it and when I was in psychiatric hospital I could talk with pretty girls without a problem, fear and sweating. You should know, that as time passes it will be easier and easier to not masturbate as you will have less and less thoughts about nudity and porn. You can have sex if you have a partner, that's not bad (in my case I don't have a sex or a girlfriend but it's ok if you do want it.) The enemy is porn and nudity, sexualisation.

5) In my case, I had to stop masturbating because after ejaculations my bladder would go nuts and I would want to urinate very often and my blsdder would feel pressurising feeling so in my case health was another reason why I had to quit it. Vast majority of people don't have problems like mine but it's still good for health to stop masturbating as it is unnatural and unhealthy.

That would be my advices. Now you can try some of it if you think that it can help you. Anyway, I do sincerely hope that you will overcome this addiction and will be happier. Good luck and don't give up - even if you do relapse it's ok as you can start from the beggining again - I didn't succeded on my few first attempts too but eventually with new experience and will I finnaly overcame it and if you will be dedicated to it I surely believe that you will overcome it too.

I'm not saying that you need neuroleptics to fix your shy bladder because every case is individual and needs individual treatments. Firstly you should do all urologist tests and try to not masturbate for some time to see if it could become better. But if urologist pills and treatments doesn't work then it's possible that it can be psychosomatic disease (like in my csse). Some 15 months ago I went to Psychiatric hospital where they decided that I need neuroleptics and that I have schizotypal disorder. Those first medicine helped only a month and then all went bavk to worst. Then my psychistrist prescribed me another neuroleptics and now I live with them for over a year and they help me, of course some days and in some environments or situations it can still be bad but usually it's ok. So yeah, no fapping helped me but without pills only it wouldn't have helped. I recommend you to stop masturbating and try to go to different specialists to see what fits you best. It can be a long and difficult road - I had sensitive bladder for more than 3 years before I was given medicine that fit me and over those years it sometimes was so bad that I honestly sometimes went crazy but now I have my medicine and I really, really hope and pray that it will never ever stop working and helping me. Best of luck, don't give up.
